title: Mitch Coleman
text:
Cybersecurity Officer | Application Engineer | Machine Learning Enthusiast

mitchlcoleman@gmail.com | github.com/colema01 | linkedin.com/in/mitch-coleman-3646ba158



Cybersecurity Officer at MadisonHealth, overseeing HIPAA Security, access control, and all technical infrastructure security.


Cybersecurity operations, infrastructure security, penetration testing, scripting automation, healthcare compliance, technical support, and software integration.




Programming: Python, C#, Clojure, PowerShell, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Java, C++, Powershell
Tools: Batch Scripting, Networking, Windows/Linux Systems, Web Development

Cybersecurity: Risk Assessment, Access Management, HIPAA Compliance (Security & Access), Incident Response, Technical Leadership





Expected December 2025
Brigham Young University–Idaho, Rexburg, ID
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science — Emphasis in Machine Learning
GPA: 3.6



Mar 2024 – Present
Cybersecurity Officer, MadisonHealth, Rexburg, ID
- Head of the cybersecurity department, managing all technical infrastructure and security operations.
- Oversee HIPAA Security Rule compliance, specifically focused on access control, user authentication, and audit controls.
- Lead investigations into breaches and security incidents, ensuring documentation, mitigation, and regulatory compliance.
- Develop and enforce security policies and technical controls across the hospital’s IT ecosystem.
- Collaborate with IT and executive leadership to drive cybersecurity strategies aligned with organizational goals.
Sep 2023 – Mar 2024
Application Engineer, MadisonHealth, Rexburg, ID
- Designed and supported software tools and internal web applications for clinical and administrative teams.
- Streamlined workflow through automation and scripting, reducing manual entry and improving reliability.
- Led upgrades and transitions of legacy systems to newer, more secure technologies.
Mar 2023 – Sep 2023
Jr. Cybersecurity Analyst, MadisonHealth, Rexburg, ID
- Supported cybersecurity operations with endpoint protection, log monitoring, and user access auditing.
- Implemented batch scripting for scheduled maintenance and automated security tasks.
- Contributed to compliance efforts and participated in security reviews and documentation.
Apr 2022 – Mar 2023
Help Desk Technician, MadisonHealth, Rexburg, ID
- Provided tier-one technical support for hospital staff, resolving hardware, software, and access issues.
- Authored support documentation and delivered onboarding training for new employees.
- Recognized for excellent communication and fast issue resolution.
Aug 2019 – Aug 2021
Mission Volunteer, The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Jamaica
- Served full-time in leadership and service capacities across diverse communities.
- Gained experience in public speaking, conflict resolution, and team mentoring.
